﻿Wa-Chaa x The RZA - Grandmaster Collection Clipping
TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
Launch date: November 10, 2026
✔  You do not need a dedicated page for this campaign. You can post on any page.
 WHAT TO DO
Download videos from the official Wa-Chaa content folder.
Clip the best moments and post them to your page.
Post on TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts.
There is no set format. Use your own style and angle.
Use only footage from the official content folder.
Content Folder: https://f.io/LGgDvyP3 
	 CAPTION GUIDELINES (REQUIRED)
MUST INCLUDE
✔  Tag the Wa-Chaa account in your caption.
* TikTok: @wachaaworldwide
* Instagram: @wachaaworldwide
* YouTube Shorts: @WACHAAWorldwide
	YOUR CHOICE
Everything else is up to you. Write your own caption around the tag.
EXAMPLES
* Snack with a soundtrack. The RZA introduces the Grandmaster Collection 🥜🔥@wachaaworldwide
* spicy peanuts and a tiny vinyl you gotta hear @wachaaworldwide
* RZA recorded a kung fu intro on this one @wachaaworldwide
* the @wachaaworldwide Grandmaster Collection is a limited run
* this track is a banger and so are the nuts @wachaaworldwide
* i like a soundtrack with my snack @wachaaworldwide
* yo, The RZA recorded the intro for this one and it’s wild @wachaaworldwide
* the @wachaaworldwide Grandmaster Collection is a limited run, if you're going to get it you better get on it
Keep it genuine. Write what a real fan would say.
Keep it true. No made-up facts, stats, or dates.
Write your own. Do not copy other clippers' captions.
 The RZA ACCURACY (REQUIRED)
This applies to captions, on-screen text, and titles.
❌  Do not say The RZA wrote the track.
❌  Do not call it a RZA track or RZA song.
✔  OK to say: The RZA recorded the intro.
✔  OK to say: The RZA collaborated with WA-CHAA! on this track
RZA did not write this track. It is not an RZA song.
He collaborated on a  recording of the introduction. Posts that say otherwise are rejected.
	 EDITING GUIDELINES
Background music: ALLOWED. Keep the original audio clearly audible. Music must not drown it out.
No AI voices. No AI voiceovers, AI narration, or AI-cloned voices.
Add your own on-screen text, hooks, and titles.
 REQUIREMENTS
POST SPECS
✔  High-quality posts only. No blurry or low-effort content.
✔  English content only
✔  Post must stay live for 30 days minimum
PERFORMANCE
✔  Minimum 0.50% engagement rate (1,000 views = at least 5 likes)
✔  Likes must be visible. Hidden likes = automatic rejection.
✔  Page audience should be mostly Tier 1-2 countries (30%+ Tier 3 may be removed)
✔  By participating you agree to make your post FTC compliant
 NOT ALLOWED
CONTENT
❌  Footage not from the official content folder
❌  Saying RZA wrote the track
❌  Calling it an RZA track or song
❌  Captions without the Wa-Chaa tag
❌  Low-quality or lazy uploads
❌  NSFW, violent, or controversial content
❌  Racist, homophobic, or sexual content = instant ban
❌  Reposting another creator's video as your own
❌  Exaggerated hooks, rage bait, or hate bait
❌  False or made-up claims, stats, or dates
❌  Mislabeling the content
❌  Music that drowns out the original audio
❌  AI voiceovers or AI-generated voices
ENGAGEMENT FRAUD
❌  Bait posting: unrelated viral content to farm views
❌  Spam posting: the same video on multiple accounts
❌  Story boosting: story views do not count
❌  Paid promotion or ads of any kind = permanent ban
❌  Posting the same video more than 5 times
POST VIOLATIONS
❌  Removing the post before 30 days
❌  Hidden likes
Questions? Contact the Clipping Culture team, not Wa-Chaa. We manage this campaign and are here to help.
